description: Implement the Zelda NES clone from the completed specifications in specs/final-one-shot-prd.md

goal.ultimate: A playable browser-based Zelda NES clone that boots, renders the overworld, allows combat, and supports completing Dungeon 1
constraints: No copyrighted assets (procedurally generated or placeholder)
Browser Canvas + Web Audio only (no game engines)

userStories.title: Project scaffolding and build pipeline
userStories.description: Set up the TypeScript project structure with Vite, ESLint, and all config files as specified in spec section 2-3.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json with all dependencies from spec (vite, typescript, vitest, eslint)
tsconfig.json with strict mode and settings from spec
vite.config.ts configured per spec
eslint.config.js for code quality
index.html with canvas element and styling from spec
Directory structure created: src/{core,input,world,entities,combat,rendering,animation,audio,inventory,progression,screens,data,assets,utils}
Empty placeholder files for main.ts, constants.ts, types.ts
npm install succeeds, npm run dev starts without error

userStories.title: Constants and shared types

acceptanceCriteria: src/constants.ts with NES dimensions (256x240, 256x176 play area), frame timing (60 FPS), movement speeds
src/types.ts with all interfaces: Direction, AABB, GamePhase, TileCollision, ButtonState, InputSnapshot, Entity, etc.
All types match spec section 6 schemas exactly
Types compile without errors

Unit tests for direction stack and button state transitions
